article.story: HIGH POINT, N.C. -- — Cam’Ron Fletcher scored 21 points and High Point beat Maryland-Eastern Shore 63-49 on Wednesday. Fletcher also contributed 10 rebounds for the Panthers (2-0). CJ Brown shot 3 of 5 from the field and 6 for 12 from the line to add 13 points. Isaiah Griffin finished with 18 points and two steals for the Hawks (0-2). Up next Both teams play on Saturday. High Point hosts Washington State and Maryland-Eastern Shore hosts Cheyney. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
